protocol.independent_unit: search seed within species; ten heldout interventions are repeated measurements
protocol.search_space: native per-species growth centre x[0.8,1.2], growth width x[0.5,1.5]; fixed inherited anatomy
protocol.descriptors: fixed8x8 parent-relative final mass[0.5,2] and50-step displacement[0,2]; clipped overflow
protocol.map_quality: undamaged performance; uniform archive-cell reproduction and uniform final archive-cell choice
protocol.performance_quality: valid bounded persistence x(0.5+0.5*capped parent-relative motion/2)
protocol.direct_quality: mean mass closeness x retained motion across4/6/8%; no shape reward
protocol.budget: equal candidate evaluations; coverage also equal simulated world steps; direct selection has explicitly reported extra injury compute
protocol.coverage_gate: mean species-stratified paired seed coverage difference lower95% bootstrap bound>0
protocol.gate_scope: coverage gate precedes heldout comparison; small fixed budget, no scientific novelty claim
protocol.heldout_scope: fresh initial-state seeds and specified interventions; some injury magnitudes have historical exploratory exposure
protocol.heldout_definition: 300 steps; repeated7% at0 and150; fragmentation3-cell central vertical gap; sensed-neighborhood noise sigma.015 eachstep; radius+10%; diffusion10%4-neighbor mixing eachstep; moving imposed growth field amplitude.002 cosine speed.5cells/step (no explicit resource uptake)
protocol.species_eligibility: at least90% valid parental controls; excluded species retained in diagnostics
protocol.analysis: primary functional recovery and survival averaged within seed, species reported separately; anatomy secondary; no tuning after results
